title: Recurrence-resolved locality of inferred Horn proof state

parent.negative_result: AF-06 status warmup eligible at width2 seeds17/29, while depth4/5 addressed interchange and untouched-Q controls failed; no prior scored code edited

scientific_question: Does directly conserving the semantically untouched subgoal code and its output distribution throughout downstream recurrence improve depth4/5 locality versus a forward-call-matched addressed-patch ramp, without sacrificing proof-goal semantics?

truth.oracle: Finite Horn least-fixed-point closure of explicit initial facts and public rule-incidence DAG, with Boolean cross-check; labels for patches derive only from original recipient and selected donor
truth.model_input: Initial facts, public incidence, node roles, rule arity and stage. Derived Q0, Q1, G statuses, proof traces and donor labels never enter the learned encoder.
truth.proof_scope: Lean4.19.0 generates and certifies closed Boolean equations for the synthetic oracle; does not validate learned model proofs or genuine Lean tactic synthesis.

data.source: Unchanged AF-05 six split corpus and its manifest; identical to AF-06
data.donors: Matched full public skeleton and untouched leaf values; independent oracle recomputes downstream target after exchanging only inferred selected Q value
data.heldout_access: Training and eligibility use train and dev only. Depth4/5, novel layout, novel composition and additional suffix calls are first accessed after final checkpoints are frozen.

model.cell: Exact hash-pinned original TypedLoop from experiments/lean_reasoner/train.py through AF-02 model.py
model.architecture: 15 atom and 14 rule tokens, 16 decoded working floats per token, original type-shared codec applied after each native call
model.intervention: After all upstream recurrence, patch selected Q atom code only, preserve other atom/rule codes, decode exactly once, and execute downstream graph with no upstream fact reinjection
model.trace: Retain original and patched Q logits and selected/unselected Q code displacement after every downstream call. At suffix length5, retain all five calls; only suffix length3 supplies original AF-05 scored boundary patch metrics.

training.sample: Exactly 16 depth2 and 16 depth3 cases each update; fixed Torch RNG streams shared between arms; matched donor and selection in each arm
training.optimizer: AdamW(lr=0.002, weight_decay=0.01), clip_grad_norm_ 1.0; two CPU threads; source Torch2.5.1+cpu on GitHub CI
training.initialization: Each seed-width creates one 480-step status warmup; save its checkpoint and clone tensors exactly into all continuations. Fixed final checkpoints only; dev qualification after fitting.
training.patch_budget: Status always patches other Q, while ramp and locality receive the exact same deterministic 0-to-32 addressed-mask schedule, totaling 2560 addressed rows per 160-step run. Every arm performs two upstream passes plus two downstream passes per batch, equal native recurrent calls; additional locality KL/MSE costs extra arithmetic/backward FLOPs and is reported as such.
training.shared_loss: Clean G CE +0.5 initial Q CE +0.25 post Q CE +0.1 post/pre consistency +0.75 patched G CE +0.30 patched Q CE +0.15 (clean Q CE averaged over each downstream step + patched Q CE averaged over each downstream step)
training.locality_extra: 0.25 KL from detached clean untouched-Q logits to patched untouched-Q logits +0.12 MSE between patched untouched-Q actual carried atom code and stop-gradient clean counterpart; average over all three downstream steps. Addressed and irrelevant patches select the corresponding semantically protected Q.
training.training_access: No heldout score influences training steps, regularization weights, checkpoint choice, or gate values. Incomplete or engineering smoke runs retained and labeled.

evaluation.extra_recurrence: 3- and 5-call downstream trajectories on depth4/5; only 3-call on composition/layout. All predicted per-step Q logits and protected-code displacement retained per pair.
evaluation.independent_verifier: Reconstruct every clean, patched and per-step Horn target; guard complete row rosters and logits; test original patch vs direct donor; replay pinned weights and sampled entire suffix trajectories and actual code distances; verify source hashes and both frozen arrays.
evaluation.training_gate: Warmup/status/ramp/locality each reach >=0.80 original goal and exact joint Q accuracy separately on train and dev; eligibility checked independently in each seed-width.
evaluation.primary_gate: Within each eligible width2 seed and both depth families, locality minus ramp untouched Q correctness >=0.10 at suffix3, mean over the 3 protected Q stages improves >=0.05; clean goal falls <=0.03; informative addressed-goal accuracy falls <=0.03; locality irrelevant-patch goal retention >=0.90 and no more than 0.02 below ramp; after 5 suffix calls protected Q correctness no more than 0.02 below 3 suffix calls; false-positive goal attempts do not increase. An eligible failure fails the aggregate, all seeds eligible and passing gives aggregate pass, otherwise inconclusive.
evaluation.limits: Equal recurrent-call counts, not equal wall-clock FLOPs. Suffix5 is tensor-only extrapolation; no independent original Lean theorem certificate for extra cycles. Causal localization on this structured Horn DAG does not establish latent language-model proof discovery.

evidence.freeze: Store source-commit SHA and source-file digests, frozen PROTOCOL.json and corpus receipt before training
evidence.models: Six warm-up checkpoints and 18 continuation models, Torch .pt and NumPy .npz exports; all seeds and failures kept
evidence.logs: Retain training and train/dev logits before test; heldout clean and original three-condition patch records; all per-step 3/5 call traces; independent report and hashes
evidence.acceptance: Engineering CI gate depends on source integrity and oracle checks, independent reconstruction and numerical replay. Scientific threshold failure never makes the CI job fail.
